title: The Visitor of Cold Spring
author: Edmund Blackwood
blurb: Odile Voss, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
